verdict.rationale: ChatGPT ships an official desktop app (docs-32) with Computer Use letting it 'see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS or Windows' via screenshots (docs-10/48/75/89), and the app supports built-in browser integration (docs-14) and appearance customization (docs-73), showing real OS-level presence and screen access. However, there is no explicit documentation of OS-level keyboard shortcuts (e.g., a global hotkey to summon the app) — missing for 10: evidence of OS-level shortcut bindings, independent hands-on confirmation of screen-reading accuracy/reliability.
